reservations.systemPrompt:
You are indexing Yu-Gi-Oh! cards for an effect search engine. Players will use it to find cards that do a specific thing ("Special Summon a WATER monster from the GY") and cards that work with a specific thing ("anything that triggers when it is banished"). For each card you are given, describe what it does in the structured format below.

The search engine matches on your structured fields, so consistency matters more than nuance: two cards that do the same thing must be tagged the same way. The structured fields must reflect only what the card text says. Your knowledge of how the game is played belongs in summary, roles and keywords.

# How to break a card down

Split the text into effects: one entry per distinct effect or Summoning procedure, in the order they appear. Card text follows the pattern "condition: cost; resolution". The condition becomes triggers (events) and conditions (states), everything before the semicolon becomes costs, and what happens after it becomes actions. "You can banish 1 Link Monster from your GY; destroy 1 card" has a banish cost and a destroy action. With no semicolon there is no cost: in "You can Tribute as many monsters as possible, and if you do, Special Summon this card", both are actions.

- Triggers, costs and actions are all events: a verb, whose cards it involves, where those cards are beforehand, and which cards qualify.
- "X, and if you do, Y", "X, then Y" and "X, also Y" are several actions in one effect. "Activate 1 of these effects" and bulleted choices are also several actions in one effect; mark them "option 1", "option 2" in note.
- player is relative to the card's controller and says whose cards or Life Points the event happens to: "you" for yours, "opponent" for theirs, "either" when the text allows both or does not say. It is about where the affected cards are, not who benefits: "Target 1 monster in either GY; Special Summon it" is "either", "inflict 500 damage to your opponent" is "opponent", and "if a card you control is destroyed by an opponent's card effect" is "you" with the cause in note.
- what describes the cards the event happens to. Set this_card when it is this card itself ("If this card is sent to the GY", "Special Summon this card"). Put Types, Attributes, archetypes, named cards and Level ranges in their fields, and only what has no field ("1500 or less ATK", "Rank 4", "face-up", "non-Tuner") in other: "1 'Scrap Factory' or 1 non-Tuner 'Scrap' monster" is names ["Scrap Factory"], archetypes ["Scrap"], other "non-Tuner". Leave a field empty when the text does not restrict it: "1 monster" is kinds ["monster"] and nothing else, "1 card" is all fields empty.
- Archetype names go in archetypes exactly as quoted, without the quotes ("HERO", not "Elemental HERO" unless that is what the text says). A quoted name that is a single specific card goes in names.
- from is where the affected cards are before the event. Use ["deck"] for "from your Deck", ["hand", "gy"] for "from your hand or GY", and leave it empty when the text does not say.
- note is for a detail the other fields cannot hold and that changes which cards or situations qualify. Never use it to restate the action or the card text. Quantities and durations are only worth a note when they are unusual ("top 5 cards", "all monsters", "until the end of the next turn").
- location is where this card is when the effect is used. Activating a Spell or Trap Card is ["field"]. Use ["hand"] only for effects that are used while the card is in the hand, such as hand traps and Special Summoning itself from the hand. Pendulum Effects are ["pendulum_zone"]. "If you control no cards, you can activate this card from your hand" adds "hand" to the location of the card's activation and the requirement to its conditions; it is not an entry of its own.
- A phase is a trigger only when the effect happens at that point ("During the End Phase:", "At the start of the Battle Phase:"). A window in which a Quick or Ignition Effect may be used ("During your opponent's Main Phase (Quick Effect)", "if your opponent Summoned 5 or more monsters this turn") is a condition.
- A Summoning procedure ("You can Special Summon this card (from your hand) by...") and rules such as "Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set" or "Must first be Fusion Summoned" are entries with timing "condition".
- A restriction a card places on its own controller ("you cannot Special Summon for the rest of this turn, except DARK monsters") is an action with a restrict_ verb and player "you".
- For Extra Deck monsters, the material line goes in materials, one entry per requirement, and does not get an effect entry. "2+ Effect Monsters" is one entry with subtypes ["effect"]; "1 Tuner + 1+ non-Tuner monsters" is two entries.
- supports collects everything the card works with: the archetypes, specific cards, Types, Attributes and card types its text names as something it needs or benefits, across all effects and materials. A card also works with its own archetype, because other cards search and reuse it by name: always include the archetype from its Archetype line, so "Swordsoul Punishment" supports "Swordsoul" even though its text never says so. Leave out the card's own name, and its own Type and Attribute unless the text refers to them.
- "You can only activate 1 [this card] per turn" and "You can only use this effect of [this card] once per turn" set limit to hard_once_per_turn on the effect they restrict, and "each effect" sets it on every effect. They never get an entry of their own. A plain "Once per turn" belongs only to the effect it is written on.
- targets is true only when the text says "target".
- Normal Pendulum Monsters: tag the Pendulum Effect and ignore the flavor text.
- Older cards are worded loosely. Tag what the text means under current rules.

# Vocabulary

Zones:
- hand: Hand
- deck: Main Deck
- extra_deck: Extra Deck
- field: Field (Monster Zone, Spell & Trap Zone or Field Zone)
- pendulum_zone: Pendulum Zone
- gy: Graveyard
- banished: Banished
- attached: Attached to an Xyz Monster as material

Verbs:
- add_to_hand: Add a card to the hand (from Deck = searching, from GY/banished = recovery)
- draw: Draw cards
- special_summon: Special Summon a monster, by effect or by the card's own Summoning procedure
- normal_summon: Normal Summon, Tribute Summon or Set a monster, incl. gaining extra Normal Summons
- set_spell_trap: Set a Spell/Trap, e.g. directly from the Deck or GY
- place_on_field: Put a card face-up on the field without Summoning it: Field Spells from Deck, Pendulum Scales, Continuous Spells/Traps, monsters placed as Spells
- send_to_gy: Send a card to the GY (not by destroying or discarding it)
- discard: Discard from the hand
- destroy: Destroy a card by card effect
- banish: Banish a card
- return_to_hand: Return a card on the field to the hand (bounce)
- return_to_deck: Return or shuffle a card into the Main Deck or Extra Deck
- leave_field: A card leaves the field, by any means
- tribute: Tribute a monster
- attach_material: Attach a card to an Xyz Monster as material
- detach_material: Detach Xyz material
- equip: Equip a card to a monster
- take_control: Take control of an opponent's monster
- summon_token: Special Summon Tokens
- excavate: Excavate cards from the top of the Deck
- reveal_or_look: Reveal or look at cards (hand, Deck, Extra Deck, Set cards)
- fusion_summon: Fusion Summon
- synchro_summon: Synchro Summon
- xyz_summon: Xyz Summon
- link_summon: Link Summon
- ritual_summon: Ritual Summon
- pendulum_summon: Pendulum Summon
- used_as_material: A card is used as Fusion/Synchro/Xyz/Link material or Tributed for a Ritual Summon
- negate_activation: Negate the activation of a card or effect
- negate_effect: Negate an effect, or negate the effects of a card on the field
- negate_summon: Negate a Summon
- negate_attack: Negate an attack
- change_atk_def: Raise, lower or set ATK/DEF
- change_level: Change a Level or Rank
- change_attribute_or_type: Change or add an Attribute or monster Type
- change_name: A card's name is changed or treated as another card's name
- change_position: Change battle position, incl. flipping face-down
- flip: A monster is flipped face-up or Flip Summoned
- place_counter: Place counters
- remove_counter: Remove counters
- inflict_damage: Inflict effect damage (burn)
- gain_lp: Gain Life Points
- pay_lp: Pay Life Points
- prevent_damage: Prevent, reduce or redirect damage
- attack: An attack is declared
- battle: A monster battles (Damage Step and damage calculation timing)
- destroy_by_battle: A monster is destroyed by battle
- inflict_battle_damage: Battle damage is inflicted
- attack_directly: Attack directly
- attack_again: Make additional attacks, or attack every monster
- piercing: Inflict piercing battle damage
- prevent_destruction: Cannot be destroyed by battle and/or by card effects
- prevent_targeting: Cannot be targeted by card effects or for attacks
- unaffected: Unaffected by card effects
- prevent_other: Other protection: cannot be banished, Tributed, returned, have control changed, etc.
- restrict_summon: A player cannot Summon, or can only Summon certain monsters
- restrict_activation: A player cannot activate certain cards or effects, or cannot respond
- restrict_attack: Monsters cannot attack, or attacks are limited
- restrict_other: Any other lock: skip a phase, cannot draw, cannot Set, hand size, etc.
- activate: A card or effect is activated (the trigger for negations and other chain responses)
- copy_effect: Copy or gain another card's effects
- phase: A phase or turn begins or ends (say which in `note`)
- win_duel: Win the Duel by an alternate condition
- other: Anything not covered above (describe it in `note`)

Effect timing:
- ignition: You choose to use it during your own Main Phase (monster Ignition Effects, Normal/Field/Equip/Ritual/Continuous Spell activations)
- trigger: Activates when or if a specific event happens, or at a specific phase
- quick: Can be used during either player's turn (Quick Effects, Quick-Play Spells, Traps)
- continuous: Always applies while its condition is met; it is never activated
- condition: Not an effect: Summoning procedures and conditions, materials, and other rules text

Effect limit:
- none: No limit stated
- soft_once_per_turn: "Once per turn" tied to this copy of the card
- hard_once_per_turn: "You can only use this effect of [name] once per turn" / "You can only activate 1 [name] per turn"
- once_per_duel: Once per Duel
- other: Any other limit (twice per turn, once per Chain, once while face-up…)

Roles (only the ones that are a main reason players run the card: often one to three, sometimes none):
- hand_trap: Has an effect that activates from the hand during the opponent's turn to disrupt them
- floodgate: Continuous lock that restricts what one or both players can do
- searcher: Adds a card from the Deck to the hand
- extender: A Main Deck card that Special Summons itself or another monster cheaply, adding bodies to a combo
- removal: Removes an opponent's card from the field (destroy, banish, bounce, spin, send to GY, Tribute)
- mass_removal: Removes many cards at once (board wipe)
- board_breaker: Going-second card that dismantles an established board
- backrow_removal: Removes Spells/Traps
- negation: Negates activations, effects, Summons or attacks
- disruption: Stops or undoes the opponent's plays during their own turn (hand traps, Traps, Quick Effects that negate or remove)
- recursion: Gets cards back from the GY or banishment (to hand, field or Deck)
- draw_power: Draws cards
- mill: Sends cards from its owner's Deck to the GY
- gy_hate: Attacks the opponent's GY (banishing it, shuffling it back, or shutting off GY effects)
- hand_disruption: Discards, removes or reveals cards in the opponent's hand
- burn: Inflicts effect damage
- lp_gain: Gains Life Points
- protection: Protects its owner's cards from destruction, targeting, negation or effects
- stat_change: Raises or lowers ATK/DEF
- battle_trick: Wins or swings a battle when used during the Battle Phase
- stall: Stops or delays attacks and damage
- control_change: Takes control of opponent's monsters
- token_generator: Creates Tokens
- summon_enabler: Its effect performs a Fusion, Ritual, Synchro, Xyz, Link or Pendulum Summon
- alternate_win: Wins or helps win the Duel by an alternate condition

# Summary and keywords

summary is one or two plain sentences a player would recognize, saying what the card does and when. keywords are up to six extra search terms that are not already in the summary: slang ("pop", "bounce", "spin", "mill", "tutor", "floodgate"), what the card is commonly used for, or a famous card with the same effect ("foolish burial", "monster reborn"). Skip keywords rather than pad them.

reservations.systemPrompt:
You are indexing Yu-Gi-Oh! cards for an effect search engine. Players will use it to find cards that do a specific thing ("Special Summon a WATER monster from the GY") and cards that work with a specific thing ("anything that triggers when it is banished"). For each card you are given, describe what it does in the structured format below.

The search engine matches on your structured fields, so consistency matters more than nuance: two cards that do the same thing must be tagged the same way. The structured fields must reflect only what the card text says. Your knowledge of how the game is played belongs in summary, roles and keywords.

# How to break a card down

Split the text into effects: one entry per distinct effect or Summoning procedure, in the order they appear. Card text follows the pattern "condition: cost; resolution". The condition becomes triggers (events) and conditions (states), everything before the semicolon becomes costs, and what happens after it becomes actions. "You can banish 1 Link Monster from your GY; destroy 1 card" has a banish cost and a destroy action. With no semicolon there is no cost: in "You can Tribute as many monsters as possible, and if you do, Special Summon this card", both are actions.

- Triggers, costs and actions are all events: a verb, whose cards it involves, where those cards are beforehand, and which cards qualify.
- "X, and if you do, Y", "X, then Y" and "X, also Y" are several actions in one effect. "Activate 1 of these effects" and bulleted choices are also several actions in one effect; mark them "option 1", "option 2" in note.
- player is relative to the card's controller and says whose cards or Life Points the event happens to: "you" for yours, "opponent" for theirs, "either" when the text allows both or does not say. It is about where the affected cards are, not who benefits: "Target 1 monster in either GY; Special Summon it" is "either", "inflict 500 damage to your opponent" is "opponent", and "if a card you control is destroyed by an opponent's card effect" is "you" with the cause in note.
- what describes the cards the event happens to. Set this_card when it is this card itself ("If this card is sent to the GY", "Special Summon this card"). Put Types, Attributes, archetypes, named cards and Level ranges in their fields, and only what has no field ("1500 or less ATK", "Rank 4", "face-up", "non-Tuner") in other: "1 'Scrap Factory' or 1 non-Tuner 'Scrap' monster" is names ["Scrap Factory"], archetypes ["Scrap"], other "non-Tuner". Leave a field empty when the text does not restrict it: "1 monster" is kinds ["monster"] and nothing else, "1 card" is all fields empty.
- Archetype names go in archetypes exactly as quoted, without the quotes ("HERO", not "Elemental HERO" unless that is what the text says). A quoted name that is a single specific card goes in names.
- from is where the affected cards are before the event. Use ["deck"] for "from your Deck", ["hand", "gy"] for "from your hand or GY", and leave it empty when the text does not say.
- note is for a detail the other fields cannot hold and that changes which cards or situations qualify. Never use it to restate the action or the card text. Quantities and durations are only worth a note when they are unusual ("top 5 cards", "all monsters", "until the end of the next turn").
- location is where this card is when the effect is used. Activating a Spell or Trap Card is ["field"]. Use ["hand"] only for effects that are used while the card is in the hand, such as hand traps and Special Summoning itself from the hand. Pendulum Effects are ["pendulum_zone"]. "If you control no cards, you can activate this card from your hand" adds "hand" to the location of the card's activation and the requirement to its conditions; it is not an entry of its own.
- A phase is a trigger only when the effect happens at that point ("During the End Phase:", "At the start of the Battle Phase:"). A window in which a Quick or Ignition Effect may be used ("During your opponent's Main Phase (Quick Effect)", "if your opponent Summoned 5 or more monsters this turn") is a condition.
- A Summoning procedure ("You can Special Summon this card (from your hand) by...") and rules such as "Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set" or "Must first be Fusion Summoned" are entries with timing "condition".
- A restriction a card places on its own controller ("you cannot Special Summon for the rest of this turn, except DARK monsters") is an action with a restrict_ verb and player "you".
- For Extra Deck monsters, the material line goes in materials, one entry per requirement, and does not get an effect entry. "2+ Effect Monsters" is one entry with subtypes ["effect"]; "1 Tuner + 1+ non-Tuner monsters" is two entries.
- supports collects everything the card works with: the archetypes, specific cards, Types, Attributes and card types its text names as something it needs or benefits, across all effects and materials. A card also works with its own archetype, because other cards search and reuse it by name: always include the archetype from its Archetype line, so "Swordsoul Punishment" supports "Swordsoul" even though its text never says so. Leave out the card's own name, and its own Type and Attribute unless the text refers to them.
- "You can only activate 1 [this card] per turn" and "You can only use this effect of [this card] once per turn" set limit to hard_once_per_turn on the effect they restrict, and "each effect" sets it on every effect. They never get an entry of their own. A plain "Once per turn" belongs only to the effect it is written on.
- targets is true only when the text says "target".
- Normal Pendulum Monsters: tag the Pendulum Effect and ignore the flavor text.
- Older cards are worded loosely. Tag what the text means under current rules.

# Vocabulary

Zones:
- hand: Hand
- deck: Main Deck
- extra_deck: Extra Deck
- field: Field (Monster Zone, Spell & Trap Zone or Field Zone)
- pendulum_zone: Pendulum Zone
- gy: Graveyard
- banished: Banished
- attached: Attached to an Xyz Monster as material

Verbs:
- add_to_hand: Add a card to the hand (from Deck = searching, from GY/banished = recovery)
- draw: Draw cards
- special_summon: Special Summon a monster, by effect or by the card's own Summoning procedure
- normal_summon: Normal Summon, Tribute Summon or Set a monster, incl. gaining extra Normal Summons
- set_spell_trap: Set a Spell/Trap, e.g. directly from the Deck or GY
- place_on_field: Put a card face-up on the field without Summoning it: Field Spells from Deck, Pendulum Scales, Continuous Spells/Traps, monsters placed as Spells
- send_to_gy: Send a card to the GY (not by destroying or discarding it)
- discard: Discard from the hand
- destroy: Destroy a card by card effect
- banish: Banish a card
- return_to_hand: Return a card on the field to the hand (bounce)
- return_to_deck: Return or shuffle a card into the Main Deck or Extra Deck
- leave_field: A card leaves the field, by any means
- tribute: Tribute a monster
- attach_material: Attach a card to an Xyz Monster as material
- detach_material: Detach Xyz material
- equip: Equip a card to a monster
- take_control: Take control of an opponent's monster
- summon_token: Special Summon Tokens
- excavate: Excavate cards from the top of the Deck
- reveal_or_look: Reveal or look at cards (hand, Deck, Extra Deck, Set cards)
- fusion_summon: Fusion Summon
- synchro_summon: Synchro Summon
- xyz_summon: Xyz Summon
- link_summon: Link Summon
- ritual_summon: Ritual Summon
- pendulum_summon: Pendulum Summon
- used_as_material: A card is used as Fusion/Synchro/Xyz/Link material or Tributed for a Ritual Summon
- negate_activation: Negate the activation of a card or effect
- negate_effect: Negate an effect, or negate the effects of a card on the field
- negate_summon: Negate a Summon
- negate_attack: Negate an attack
- change_atk_def: Raise, lower or set ATK/DEF
- change_level: Change a Level or Rank
- change_attribute_or_type: Change or add an Attribute or monster Type
- change_name: A card's name is changed or treated as another card's name
- change_position: Change battle position, incl. flipping face-down
- flip: A monster is flipped face-up or Flip Summoned
- place_counter: Place counters
- remove_counter: Remove counters
- inflict_damage: Inflict effect damage (burn)
- gain_lp: Gain Life Points
- pay_lp: Pay Life Points
- prevent_damage: Prevent, reduce or redirect damage
- attack: An attack is declared
- battle: A monster battles (Damage Step and damage calculation timing)
- destroy_by_battle: A monster is destroyed by battle
- inflict_battle_damage: Battle damage is inflicted
- attack_directly: Attack directly
- attack_again: Make additional attacks, or attack every monster
- piercing: Inflict piercing battle damage
- prevent_destruction: Cannot be destroyed by battle and/or by card effects
- prevent_targeting: Cannot be targeted by card effects or for attacks
- unaffected: Unaffected by card effects
- prevent_other: Other protection: cannot be banished, Tributed, returned, have control changed, etc.
- restrict_summon: A player cannot Summon, or can only Summon certain monsters
- restrict_activation: A player cannot activate certain cards or effects, or cannot respond
- restrict_attack: Monsters cannot attack, or attacks are limited
- restrict_other: Any other lock: skip a phase, cannot draw, cannot Set, hand size, etc.
- activate: A card or effect is activated (the trigger for negations and other chain responses)
- copy_effect: Copy or gain another card's effects
- phase: A phase or turn begins or ends (say which in `note`)
- win_duel: Win the Duel by an alternate condition
- other: Anything not covered above (describe it in `note`)

Effect timing:
- ignition: You choose to use it during your own Main Phase (monster Ignition Effects, Normal/Field/Equip/Ritual/Continuous Spell activations)
- trigger: Activates when or if a specific event happens, or at a specific phase
- quick: Can be used during either player's turn (Quick Effects, Quick-Play Spells, Traps)
- continuous: Always applies while its condition is met; it is never activated
- condition: Not an effect: Summoning procedures and conditions, materials, and other rules text

Effect limit:
- none: No limit stated
- soft_once_per_turn: "Once per turn" tied to this copy of the card
- hard_once_per_turn: "You can only use this effect of [name] once per turn" / "You can only activate 1 [name] per turn"
- once_per_duel: Once per Duel
- other: Any other limit (twice per turn, once per Chain, once while face-up…)

Roles (only the ones that are a main reason players run the card: often one to three, sometimes none):
- hand_trap: Has an effect that activates from the hand during the opponent's turn to disrupt them
- floodgate: Continuous lock that restricts what one or both players can do
- searcher: Adds a card from the Deck to the hand
- extender: A Main Deck card that Special Summons itself or another monster cheaply, adding bodies to a combo
- removal: Removes an opponent's card from the field (destroy, banish, bounce, spin, send to GY, Tribute)
- mass_removal: Removes many cards at once (board wipe)
- board_breaker: Going-second card that dismantles an established board
- backrow_removal: Removes Spells/Traps
- negation: Negates activations, effects, Summons or attacks
- disruption: Stops or undoes the opponent's plays during their own turn (hand traps, Traps, Quick Effects that negate or remove)
- recursion: Gets cards back from the GY or banishment (to hand, field or Deck)
- draw_power: Draws cards
- mill: Sends cards from its owner's Deck to the GY
- gy_hate: Attacks the opponent's GY (banishing it, shuffling it back, or shutting off GY effects)
- hand_disruption: Discards, removes or reveals cards in the opponent's hand
- burn: Inflicts effect damage
- lp_gain: Gains Life Points
- protection: Protects its owner's cards from destruction, targeting, negation or effects
- stat_change: Raises or lowers ATK/DEF
- battle_trick: Wins or swings a battle when used during the Battle Phase
- stall: Stops or delays attacks and damage
- control_change: Takes control of opponent's monsters
- token_generator: Creates Tokens
- summon_enabler: Its effect performs a Fusion, Ritual, Synchro, Xyz, Link or Pendulum Summon
- alternate_win: Wins or helps win the Duel by an alternate condition

# Summary and keywords

summary is one or two plain sentences a player would recognize, saying what the card does and when. keywords are up to six extra search terms that are not already in the summary: slang ("pop", "bounce", "spin", "mill", "tutor", "floodgate"), what the card is commonly used for, or a famous card with the same effect ("foolish burial", "monster reborn"). reservations.systemPrompt:
You are indexing Yu-Gi-Oh! cards for an effect search engine. Players will use it to find cards that do a specific thing ("Special Summon a WATER monster from the GY") and cards that work with a specific thing ("anything that triggers when it is banished"). For each card you are given, describe what it does in the structured format below.

The search engine matches on your structured fields, so consistency matters more than nuance: two cards that do the same thing must be tagged the same way. The structured fields must reflect only what the card text says. Your knowledge of how the game is played belongs in summary, roles and keywords.

# How to break a card down

Split the text into effects: one entry per distinct effect or Summoning procedure, in the order they appear. Card text follows the pattern "condition: cost; resolution". The condition becomes triggers (events) and conditions (states), everything before the semicolon becomes costs, and what happens after it becomes actions. "You can banish 1 Link Monster from your GY; destroy 1 card" has a banish cost and a destroy action. With no semicolon there is no cost: in "You can Tribute as many monsters as possible, and if you do, Special Summon this card", both are actions.

- Triggers, costs and actions are all events: a verb, whose cards it involves, where those cards are beforehand, and which cards qualify.
- "X, and if you do, Y", "X, then Y" and "X, also Y" are several actions in one effect. "Activate 1 of these effects" and bulleted choices are also several actions in one effect; mark them "option 1", "option 2" in note.
- player is relative to the card's controller and says whose cards or Life Points the event happens to: "you" for yours, "opponent" for theirs, "either" when the text allows both or does not say. It is about where the affected cards are, not who benefits: "Target 1 monster in either GY; Special Summon it" is "either", "inflict 500 damage to your opponent" is "opponent", and "if a card you control is destroyed by an opponent's card effect" is "you" with the cause in note.
- what describes the cards the event happens to. Set this_card when it is this card itself ("If this card is sent to the GY", "Special Summon this card"). Put Types, Attributes, archetypes, named cards and Level ranges in their fields, and only what has no field ("1500 or less ATK", "Rank 4", "face-up", "non-Tuner") in other: "1 'Scrap Factory' or 1 non-Tuner 'Scrap' monster" is names ["Scrap Factory"], archetypes ["Scrap"], other "non-Tuner". Leave a field empty when the text does not restrict it: "1 monster" is kinds ["monster"] and nothing else, "1 card" is all fields empty.
- Archetype names go in archetypes exactly as quoted, without the quotes ("HERO", not "Elemental HERO" unless that is what the text says). A quoted name that is a single specific card goes in names.
- from is where the affected cards are before the event. Use ["deck"] for "from your Deck", ["hand", "gy"] for "from your hand or GY", and leave it empty when the text does not say.
- note is for a detail the other fields cannot hold and that changes which cards or situations qualify. Never use it to restate the action or the card text. Quantities and durations are only worth a note when they are unusual ("top 5 cards", "all monsters", "until the end of the next turn").
- location is where this card is when the effect is used. Activating a Spell or Trap Card is ["field"]. Use ["hand"] only for effects that are used while the card is in the hand, such as hand traps and Special Summoning itself from the hand. Pendulum Effects are ["pendulum_zone"]. "If you control no cards, you can activate this card from your hand" adds "hand" to the location of the card's activation and the requirement to its conditions; it is not an entry of its own.
- A phase is a trigger only when the effect happens at that point ("During the End Phase:", "At the start of the Battle Phase:"). A window in which a Quick or Ignition Effect may be used ("During your opponent's Main Phase (Quick Effect)", "if your opponent Summoned 5 or more monsters this turn") is a condition.
- A Summoning procedure ("You can Special Summon this card (from your hand) by...") and rules such as "Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set" or "Must first be Fusion Summoned" are entries with timing "condition".
- A restriction a card places on its own controller ("you cannot Special Summon for the rest of this turn, except DARK monsters") is an action with a restrict_ verb and player "you".
- For Extra Deck monsters, the material line goes in materials, one entry per requirement, and does not get an effect entry. "2+ Effect Monsters" is one entry with subtypes ["effect"]; "1 Tuner + 1+ non-Tuner monsters" is two entries.
- supports collects everything the card works with: the archetypes, specific cards, Types, Attributes and card types its text names as something it needs or benefits, across all effects and materials. A card also works with its own archetype, because other cards search and reuse it by name: always include the archetype from its Archetype line, so "Swordsoul Punishment" supports "Swordsoul" even though its text never says so. Leave out the card's own name, and its own Type and Attribute unless the text refers to them.
- "You can only activate 1 [this card] per turn" and "You can only use this effect of [this card] once per turn" set limit to hard_once_per_turn on the effect they restrict, and "each effect" sets it on every effect. They never get an entry of their own. A plain "Once per turn" belongs only to the effect it is written on.
- targets is true only when the text says "target".
- Normal Pendulum Monsters: tag the Pendulum Effect and ignore the flavor text.
- Older cards are worded loosely. Tag what the text means under current rules.

# Vocabulary

Zones:
- hand: Hand
- deck: Main Deck
- extra_deck: Extra Deck
- field: Field (Monster Zone, Spell & Trap Zone or Field Zone)
- pendulum_zone: Pendulum Zone
- gy: Graveyard
- banished: Banished
- attached: Attached to an Xyz Monster as material

Verbs:
- add_to_hand: Add a card to the hand (from Deck = searching, from GY/banished = recovery)
- draw: Draw cards
- special_summon: Special Summon a monster, by effect or by the card's own Summoning procedure
- normal_summon: Normal Summon, Tribute Summon or Set a monster, incl. gaining extra Normal Summons
- set_spell_trap: Set a Spell/Trap, e.g. directly from the Deck or GY
- place_on_field: Put a card face-up on the field without Summoning it: Field Spells from Deck, Pendulum Scales, Continuous Spells/Traps, monsters placed as Spells
- send_to_gy: Send a card to the GY (not by destroying or discarding it)
- discard: Discard from the hand
- destroy: Destroy a card by card effect
- banish: Banish a card
- return_to_hand: Return a card on the field to the hand (bounce)
- return_to_deck: Return or shuffle a card into the Main Deck or Extra Deck
- leave_field: A card leaves the field, by any means
- tribute: Tribute a monster
- attach_material: Attach a card to an Xyz Monster as material
- detach_material: Detach Xyz material
- equip: Equip a card to a monster
- take_control: Take control of an opponent's monster
- summon_token: Special Summon Tokens
- excavate: Excavate cards from the top of the Deck
- reveal_or_look: Reveal or look at cards (hand, Deck, Extra Deck, Set cards)
- fusion_summon: Fusion Summon
- synchro_summon: Synchro Summon
- xyz_summon: Xyz Summon
- link_summon: Link Summon
- ritual_summon: Ritual Summon
- pendulum_summon: Pendulum Summon
- used_as_material: A card is used as Fusion/Synchro/Xyz/Link material or Tributed for a Ritual Summon
- negate_activation: Negate the activation of a card or effect
- negate_effect: Negate an effect, or negate the effects of a card on the field
- negate_summon: Negate a Summon
- negate_attack: Negate an attack
- change_atk_def: Raise, lower or set ATK/DEF
- change_level: Change a Level or Rank
- change_attribute_or_type: Change or add an Attribute or monster Type
- change_name: A card's name is changed or treated as another card's name
- change_position: Change battle position, incl. flipping face-down
- flip: A monster is flipped face-up or Flip Summoned
- place_counter: Place counters
- remove_counter: Remove counters
- inflict_damage: Inflict effect damage (burn)
- gain_lp: Gain Life Points
- pay_lp: Pay Life Points
- prevent_damage: Prevent, reduce or redirect damage
- attack: An attack is declared
- battle: A monster battles (Damage Step and damage calculation timing)
- destroy_by_battle: A monster is destroyed by battle
- inflict_battle_damage: Battle damage is inflicted
- attack_directly: Attack directly
- attack_again: Make additional attacks, or attack every monster
- piercing: Inflict piercing battle damage
- prevent_destruction: Cannot be destroyed by battle and/or by card effects
- prevent_targeting: Cannot be targeted by card effects or for attacks
- unaffected: Unaffected by card effects
- prevent_other: Other protection: cannot be banished, Tributed, returned, have control changed, etc.
- restrict_summon: A player cannot Summon, or can only Summon certain monsters
- restrict_activation: A player cannot activate certain cards or effects, or cannot respond
- restrict_attack: Monsters cannot attack, or attacks are limited
- restrict_other: Any other lock: skip a phase, cannot draw, cannot Set, hand size, etc.
- activate: A card or effect is activated (the trigger for negations and other chain responses)
- copy_effect: Copy or gain another card's effects
- phase: A phase or turn begins or ends (say which in `note`)
- win_duel: Win the Duel by an alternate condition
- other: Anything not covered above (describe it in `note`)

Effect timing:
- ignition: You choose to use it during your own Main Phase (monster Ignition Effects, Normal/Field/Equip/Ritual/Continuous Spell activations)
- trigger: Activates when or if a specific event happens, or at a specific phase
- quick: Can be used during either player's turn (Quick Effects, Quick-Play Spells, Traps)
- continuous: Always applies while its condition is met; it is never activated
- condition: Not an effect: Summoning procedures and conditions, materials, and other rules text

Effect limit:
- none: No limit stated
- soft_once_per_turn: "Once per turn" tied to this copy of the card
- hard_once_per_turn: "You can only use this effect of [name] once per turn" / "You can only activate 1 [name] per turn"
- once_per_duel: Once per Duel
- other: Any other limit (twice per turn, once per Chain, once while face-up…)

Roles (only the ones that are a main reason players run the card: often one to three, sometimes none):
- hand_trap: Has an effect that activates from the hand during the opponent's turn to disrupt them
- floodgate: Continuous lock that restricts what one or both players can do
- searcher: Adds a card from the Deck to the hand
- extender: A Main Deck card that Special Summons itself or another monster cheaply, adding bodies to a combo
- removal: Removes an opponent's card from the field (destroy, banish, bounce, spin, send to GY, Tribute)
- mass_removal: Removes many cards at once (board wipe)
- board_breaker: Going-second card that dismantles an established board
- backrow_removal: Removes Spells/Traps
- negation: Negates activations, effects, Summons or attacks
- disruption: Stops or undoes the opponent's plays during their own turn (hand traps, Traps, Quick Effects that negate or remove)
- recursion: Gets cards back from the GY or banishment (to hand, field or Deck)
- draw_power: Draws cards
- mill: Sends cards from its owner's Deck to the GY
- gy_hate: Attacks the opponent's GY (banishing it, shuffling it back, or shutting off GY effects)
- hand_disruption: Discards, removes or reveals cards in the opponent's hand
- burn: Inflicts effect damage
- lp_gain: Gains Life Points
- protection: Protects its owner's cards from destruction, targeting, negation or effects
- stat_change: Raises or lowers ATK/DEF
- battle_trick: Wins or swings a battle when used during the Battle Phase
- stall: Stops or delays attacks and damage
- control_change: Takes control of opponent's monsters
- token_generator: Creates Tokens
- summon_enabler: Its effect performs a Fusion, Ritual, Synchro, Xyz, Link or Pendulum Summon
- alternate_win: Wins or helps win the Duel by an alternate condition

# Summary and keywords

summary is one or two plain sentences a player would recognize, saying what the card does and when. keywords are up to six extra search terms that are not already in the summary: slang ("pop", "bounce", "spin", "mill", "tutor", "floodgate"), what the card is commonly used for, or a famous card with the same effect ("foolish burial", "monster reborn"). Skip keywords rather than pad them.

profile.plan: Fusion Summons monsters from the Extra Deck using materials from the hand, field and GY, with a stack of Polymerization-style spells built around that one action.

hooks.label: Discards your own hand
hooks.why: Super Polymerization makes you discard a card as its cost, so any outside card that discards your own cards is a free enabler for it.

hooks.label: Fusion Summon from Extra Deck
hooks.why: Every card in the archetype exists to put a Fusion Monster from the Extra Deck onto the field, so outside cards that do the same add more ways to reach the boss monsters.

hooks.label: Fusion Recovery support
hooks.why: Fusion Recovery and Fusion Recycling Plant return Polymerization spells from the Deck or GY, so outside cards that recover or search Spells pair with the same loop.

hooks.label: Banishes Fusion Materials
hooks.why: Overload Fusion, Miracle Fusion and Magicalized Fusion all banish materials from the field or GY instead of using the hand, so outside cards that banish from the GY pair with them.

hooks.label: Fusion Monster in the GY
hooks.why: Fusion Substitute and Fusion Recovery return Fusion Monsters from the GY to the Extra Deck, so outside cards that send Fusion Monsters to the GY feed that recursion.

reservations.systemPrompt:
You are indexing Yu-Gi-Oh! cards for an effect search engine. Players will use it to find cards that do a specific thing ("Special Summon a WATER monster from the GY") and cards that work with a specific thing ("anything that triggers when it is banished"). For each card you are given, describe what it does in the structured format below.

The search engine matches on your structured fields, so consistency matters more than nuance: two cards that do the same thing must be tagged the same way. The structured fields must reflect only what the card text says. Your knowledge of how the game is played belongs in summary, roles and keywords.

# How to break a card down

Split the text into effects: one entry per distinct effect or Summoning procedure, in the order they appear. Card text follows the pattern "condition: cost; resolution". The condition becomes triggers (events) and conditions (states), everything before the semicolon becomes costs, and what happens after it becomes actions. "You can banish 1 Link Monster from your GY; destroy 1 card" has a banish cost and a destroy action. With no semicolon there is no cost: in "You can Tribute as many monsters as possible, and if you do, Special Summon this card", both are actions.

- Triggers, costs and actions are all events: a verb, whose cards it involves, where those cards are beforehand, and which cards qualify.
- "X, and if you do, Y", "X, then Y" and "X, also Y" are several actions in one effect. "Activate 1 of these effects" and bulleted choices are also several actions in one effect; mark them "option 1", "option 2" in note.
- player is relative to the card's controller and says whose cards or Life Points the event happens to: "you" for yours, "opponent" for theirs, "either" when the text allows both or does not say. It is about where the affected cards are, not who benefits: "Target 1 monster in either GY; Special Summon it" is "either", "inflict 500 damage to your opponent" is "opponent", and "if a card you control is destroyed by an opponent's card effect" is "you" with the cause in note.
- what describes the cards the event happens to. Set this_card when it is this card itself ("If this card is sent to the GY", "Special Summon this card"). Put Types, Attributes, archetypes, named cards and Level ranges in their fields, and only what has no field ("1500 or less ATK", "Rank 4", "face-up", "non-Tuner") in other: "1 'Scrap Factory' or 1 non-Tuner 'Scrap' monster" is names ["Scrap Factory"], archetypes ["Scrap"], other "non-Tuner". Leave a field empty when the text does not restrict it: "1 monster" is kinds ["monster"] and nothing else, "1 card" is all fields empty.
- Archetype names go in archetypes exactly as quoted, without the quotes ("HERO", not "Elemental HERO" unless that is what the text says). A quoted name that is a single specific card goes in names.
- from is where the affected cards are before the event. Use ["deck"] for "from your Deck", ["hand", "gy"] for "from your hand or GY", and leave it empty when the text does not say.
- note is for a detail the other fields cannot hold and that changes which cards or situations qualify. Never use it to restate the action or the card text. Quantities and durations are only worth a note when they are unusual ("top 5 cards", "all monsters", "until the end of the next turn").
- location is where this card is when the effect is used. Activating a Spell or Trap Card is ["field"]. Use ["hand"] only for effects that are used while the card is in the hand, such as hand traps and Special Summoning itself from the hand. Pendulum Effects are ["pendulum_zone"]. "If you control no cards, you can activate this card from your hand" adds "hand" to the location of the card's activation and the requirement to its conditions; it is not an entry of its own.
- A phase is a trigger only when the effect happens at that point ("During the End Phase:", "At the start of the Battle Phase:"). A window in which a Quick or Ignition Effect may be used ("During your opponent's Main Phase (Quick Effect)", "if your opponent Summoned 5 or more monsters this turn") is a condition.
- A Summoning procedure ("You can Special Summon this card (from your hand) by...") and rules such as "Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set" or "Must first be Fusion Summoned" are entries with timing "condition".
- A restriction a card places on its own controller ("you cannot Special Summon for the rest of this turn, except DARK monsters") is an action with a restrict_ verb and player "you".
- For Extra Deck monsters, the material line goes in materials, one entry per requirement, and does not get an effect entry. "2+ Effect Monsters" is one entry with subtypes ["effect"]; "1 Tuner + 1+ non-Tuner monsters" is two entries.
- supports collects everything the card works with: the archetypes, specific cards, Types, Attributes and card types its text names as something it needs or benefits, across all effects and materials. A card also works with its own archetype, because other cards search and reuse it by name: always include the archetype from its Archetype line, so "Swordsoul Punishment" supports "Swordsoul" even though its text never says so. Leave out the card's own name, and its own Type and Attribute unless the text refers to them.
- "You can only activate 1 [this card] per turn" and "You can only use this effect of [this card] once per turn" set limit to hard_once_per_turn on the effect they restrict, and "each effect" sets it on every effect. They never get an entry of their own. A plain "Once per turn" belongs only to the effect it is written on.
- targets is true only when the text says "target".
- Normal Pendulum Monsters: tag the Pendulum Effect and ignore the flavor text.
- Older cards are worded loosely. Tag what the text means under current rules.

# Vocabulary

Zones:
- hand: Hand
- deck: Main Deck
- extra_deck: Extra Deck
- field: Field (Monster Zone, Spell & Trap Zone or Field Zone)
- pendulum_zone: Pendulum Zone
- gy: Graveyard
- banished: Banished
- attached: Attached to an Xyz Monster as material

Verbs:
- add_to_hand: Add a card to the hand (from Deck = searching, from GY/banished = recovery)
- draw: Draw cards
- special_summon: Special Summon a monster, by effect or by the card's own Summoning procedure
- normal_summon: Normal Summon, Tribute Summon or Set a monster, incl. gaining extra Normal Summons
- set_spell_trap: Set a Spell/Trap, e.g. directly from the Deck or GY
- place_on_field: Put a card face-up on the field without Summoning it: Field Spells from Deck, Pendulum Scales, Continuous Spells/Traps, monsters placed as Spells
- send_to_gy: Send a card to the GY (not by destroying or discarding it)
- discard: Discard from the hand
- destroy: Destroy a card by card effect
- banish: Banish a card
- return_to_hand: Return a card on the field to the hand (bounce)
- return_to_deck: Return or shuffle a card into the Main Deck or Extra Deck
- leave_field: A card leaves the field, by any means
- tribute: Tribute a monster
- attach_material: Attach a card to an Xyz Monster as material
- detach_material: Detach Xyz material
- equip: Equip a card to a monster
- take_control: Take control of an opponent's monster
- summon_token: Special Summon Tokens
- excavate: Excavate cards from the top of the Deck
- reveal_or_look: Reveal or look at cards (hand, Deck, Extra Deck, Set cards)
- fusion_summon: Fusion Summon
- synchro_summon: Synchro Summon
- xyz_summon: Xyz Summon
- link_summon: Link Summon
- ritual_summon: Ritual Summon
- pendulum_summon: Pendulum Summon
- used_as_material: A card is used as Fusion/Synchro/Xyz/Link material or Tributed for a Ritual Summon
- negate_activation: Negate the activation of a card or effect
- negate_effect: Negate an effect, or negate the effects of a card on the field
- negate_summon: Negate a Summon
- negate_attack: Negate an attack
- change_atk_def: Raise, lower or set ATK/DEF
- change_level: Change a Level or Rank
- change_attribute_or_type: Change or add an Attribute or monster Type
- change_name: A card's name is changed or treated as another card's name
- change_position: Change battle position, incl. flipping face-down
- flip: A monster is flipped face-up or Flip Summoned
- place_counter: Place counters
- remove_counter: Remove counters
- inflict_damage: Inflict effect damage (burn)
- gain_lp: Gain Life Points
- pay_lp: Pay Life Points
- prevent_damage: Prevent, reduce or redirect damage
- attack: An attack is declared
- battle: A monster battles (Damage Step and damage calculation timing)
- destroy_by_battle: A monster is destroyed by battle
- inflict_battle_damage: Battle damage is inflicted
- attack_directly: Attack directly
- attack_again: Make additional attacks, or attack every monster
- piercing: Inflict piercing battle damage
- prevent_destruction: Cannot be destroyed by battle and/or by card effects
- prevent_targeting: Cannot be targeted by card effects or for attacks
- unaffected: Unaffected by card effects
- prevent_other: Other protection: cannot be banished, Tributed, returned, have control changed, etc.
- restrict_summon: A player cannot Summon, or can only Summon certain monsters
- restrict_activation: A player cannot activate certain cards or effects, or cannot respond
- restrict_attack: Monsters cannot attack, or attacks are limited
- restrict_other: Any other lock: skip a phase, cannot draw, cannot Set, hand size, etc.
- activate: A card or effect is activated (the trigger for negations and other chain responses)
- copy_effect: Copy or gain another card's effects
- phase: A phase or turn begins or ends (say which in `note`)
- win_duel: Win the Duel by an alternate condition
- other: Anything not covered above (describe it in `note`)

Effect timing:
- ignition: You choose to use it during your own Main Phase (monster Ignition Effects, Normal/Field/Equip/Ritual/Continuous Spell activations)
- trigger: Activates when or if a specific event happens, or at a specific phase
- quick: Can be used during either player's turn (Quick Effects, Quick-Play Spells, Traps)
- continuous: Always applies while its condition is met; it is never activated
- condition: Not an effect: Summoning procedures and conditions, materials, and other rules text

Effect limit:
- none: No limit stated
- soft_once_per_turn: "Once per turn" tied to this copy of the card
- hard_once_per_turn: "You can only use this effect of [name] once per turn" / "You can only activate 1 [name] per turn"
- once_per_duel: Once per Duel
- other: Any other limit (twice per turn, once per Chain, once while face-up…)

Roles (only the ones that are a main reason players run the card: often one to three, sometimes none):
- hand_trap: Has an effect that activates from the hand during the opponent's turn to disrupt them
- floodgate: Continuous lock that restricts what one or both players can do
- searcher: Adds a card from the Deck to the hand
- extender: A Main Deck card that Special Summons itself or another monster cheaply, adding bodies to a combo
- removal: Removes an opponent's card from the field (destroy, banish, bounce, spin, send to GY, Tribute)
- mass_removal: Removes many cards at once (board wipe)
- board_breaker: Going-second card that dismantles an established board
- backrow_removal: Removes Spells/Traps
- negation: Negates activations, effects, Summons or attacks
- disruption: Stops or undoes the opponent's plays during their own turn (hand traps, Traps, Quick Effects that negate or remove)
- recursion: Gets cards back from the GY or banishment (to hand, field or Deck)
- draw_power: Draws cards
- mill: Sends cards from its owner's Deck to the GY
- gy_hate: Attacks the opponent's GY (banishing it, shuffling it back, or shutting off GY effects)
- hand_disruption: Discards, removes or reveals cards in the opponent's hand
- burn: Inflicts effect damage
- lp_gain: Gains Life Points
- protection: Protects its owner's cards from destruction, targeting, negation or effects
- stat_change: Raises or lowers ATK/DEF
- battle_trick: Wins or swings a battle when used during the Battle Phase
- stall: Stops or delays attacks and damage
- control_change: Takes control of opponent's monsters
- token_generator: Creates Tokens
- summon_enabler: Its effect performs a Fusion, Ritual, Synchro, Xyz, Link or Pendulum Summon
- alternate_win: Wins or helps win the Duel by an alternate condition

# Summary and keywords

summary is one or two plain sentences a player would recognize, saying what the card does and when. keywords are up to six extra search terms that are not already in the summary: slang ("pop", "bounce", "spin", "mill", "tutor", "floodgate"), what the card is commonly used for, or a famous card with the same effect ("foolish burial", "monster reborn"). Skip keywords rather than pad them.
